dashboard.label: Activity
dashboard.description: Vendor-neutral steps, calories, activity breakdown, trends and HR training zones (Wearables data model)

{"title":"Activity","description":"Steps, calories, activity breakdown and trends","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-7d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"},"input_person":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Person (temp)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_person_list"},"options":{"token":"person","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.person_id","label":"primary.person_name"}},"input_units":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Units","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_units_opts"},"options":{"token":"units","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.units","label":"primary.units"}}},"dataSources":{"ds_activity_latest":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_activity person_id="$person$"
| eval day=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d"), _vr=case(vendor="apple",1,vendor="garmin",2,vendor="oura",3,vendor="withings",4,true(),5)
| stats max(steps) as steps max(active_calories) as active_calories max(total_calories) as total_calories max(activity_score) as score max(inactivity_alerts) as inactivity_alerts max(equiv_walk_distance_m) as equiv_walk_distance_m max(distance_m) as distance_m max(active_high_min) as active_high_min max(active_medium_min) as active_medium_min max(active_low_min) as active_low_min max(sedentary_min) as sedentary_min max(resting_min) as resting_min max(step_goal) as step_goal max(calorie_goal) as calorie_goal max(distance_goal_m) as distance_goal_m by day vendor _vr
| eval _vl=case(vendor="apple","Apple",vendor="garmin","Garmin",vendor="oura","Oura",vendor="withings","Withings",true(),vendor)
| eval steps_s=if(isnum(steps),_vl,null()), steps_d=if(isnum(steps),day,null()), acal_s=if(isnum(active_calories),_vl,null()), acal_d=if(isnum(active_calories),day,null()), tcal_s=if(isnum(total_calories),_vl,null()), tcal_d=if(isnum(total_calories),day,null()), dist_s=if(isnum(distance_m),_vl,null()), dist_d=if(isnum(distance_m),day,null())
| sort 0 -day _vr
| stats first(steps) as steps first(active_calories) as active_calories first(total_calories) as total_calories first(score) as score first(inactivity_alerts) as inactivity_alerts first(equiv_walk_distance_m) as equiv_walk_distance_m first(distance_m) as distance_m first(active_high_min) as active_high_min first(active_medium_min) as active_medium_min first(active_low_min) as active_low_min first(sedentary_min) as sedentary_min first(resting_min) as resting_min first(step_goal) as step_goal first(calorie_goal) as calorie_goal first(distance_goal_m) as distance_goal_m first(steps_s) as steps_s first(steps_d) as steps_d first(acal_s) as acal_s first(acal_d) as acal_d first(tcal_s) as tcal_s first(tcal_d) as tcal_d first(dist_s) as dist_s first(dist_d) as dist_d
| eval sg=coalesce(step_goal,10000), cg=coalesce(calorie_goal,400), dg=coalesce(distance_goal_m,8000)
| eval distance_disp=if("$units$"=="imperial", tostring(round(distance_m/1609.34,1))." mi", tostring(round(distance_m/1000,1))." km")
| eval stepcolor=case(steps>=sg,"#4CAF50",steps>=sg*0.5,"#F4A422",true(),"#E8503A"), calcolor=case(active_calories>=cg,"#4CAF50",active_calories>=cg*0.5,"#F4A422",true(),"#E8503A"), distcolor=case(distance_m>=dg,"#4CAF50",distance_m>=dg*0.5,"#F4A422",true(),"#E8503A")
| eval steps_lbl=if(isnotnull(steps_s),"via ".steps_s." · ".strftime(strptime(steps_d,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%b %d"),null()), acal_lbl=if(isnotnull(acal_s),"via ".acal_s." · ".strftime(strptime(acal_d,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%b %d"),null()), tcal_lbl=if(isnotnull(tcal_s),"via ".tcal_s." · ".strftime(strptime(tcal_d,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%b %d"),null()), dist_lbl=if(isnotnull(dist_s),"via ".dist_s." · ".strftime(strptime(dist_d,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%b %d"),null())
| table score, steps, active_calories, total_calories, distance_disp, distance_m, inactivity_alerts, equiv_walk_distance_m, active_high_min, active_medium_min, active_low_min, sedentary_min, resting_min, stepcolor, calcolor, distcolor, dg, steps_lbl, acal_lbl, tcal_lbl, dist_lbl","queryParameters":{"earliest":"-3d","latest":"now"}},"name":"Activity — latest complete day (merged, vendor-priority)"},"ds_breakdown":{"type":"ds.chain","options":{"extend":"ds_activity_latest","query":"| eval High=active_high_min, Medium=active_medium_min, Low=active_low_min, Sedentary=sedentary_min, Resting=resting_min | table High, Medium, Low, Sedentary, Resting | transpose | rename column as activity_type, "row 1" as minutes | where isnum(minutes)"},"name":"Activity time breakdown (from merged base)"},"ds_contributors":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_activity person_id="$person$"
| where isnotnull(contrib_meet_daily_targets)
| sort -_time
| head 1
| eval "Meet Daily Targets"=round(contrib_meet_daily_targets,0), "Move Every Hour"=round(contrib_move_every_hour,0), "Recovery Time"=round(contrib_recovery_time,0), "Stay Active"=round(contrib_stay_active,0), "Training Frequency"=round(contrib_training_frequency,0), "Training Volume"=round(contrib_training_volume,0)
| table "Meet Daily Targets","Move Every Hour","Recovery Time","Stay Active","Training Frequency","Training Volume"
| transpose
| rename column as contributor, "row 1" as score
| sort -score","queryParameters":{"earliest":"-2d","latest":"now"}},"name":"Activity score contributors"},"ds_steps_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_activity person_id="$person$"
| sort 0 - _indextime
| dedup _time
| timechart span=1d@d avg(steps) as Steps","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$global_time.earliest$","latest":"$global_time.latest$"}},"name":"Daily steps trend"},"ds_cal_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_activity person_id="$person$"
| sort 0 - _indextime
| dedup _time
| timechart span=1d@d avg(active_calories) as "Active Cal", avg(total_calories) as "Total Cal"","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$global_time.earliest$","latest":"$global_time.latest$"}},"name":"Calorie trend"},"ds_score_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_activity person_id="$person$"
| sort 0 - _indextime
| dedup _time
| timechart span=1d@d avg(activity_score) as Score","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$global_time.earliest$","latest":"$global_time.latest$"}},"name":"Activity score trend"},"ds_time_in_zone":{"type":"ds.chain","name":"Active time in zone (daily)","options":{"extend":"ds_zone_base","query":"| eval zone=case(pct<0.5,"Z0 Recovery",pct<0.6,"Z1 Very Light",pct<0.7,"Z2 Light",pct<0.8,"Z3 Moderate",pct<0.9,"Z4 Hard",true(),"Z5 Max")
| sort - _time
| streamstats window=1 current=false last(_time) as next_time
| sort _time
| eval next_time=coalesce(next_time,_time)
| eval duration_sec=next_time-_time
| eval duration_sec=if(duration_sec>600 OR duration_sec<0,0,duration_sec)
| where zone!="Z0 Recovery"
| eval day=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d")
| stats sum(duration_sec) as total_sec by day zone
| eval minutes=round(total_sec/60,1)
| xyseries day zone minutes
| fields day "Z5 Max" "Z4 Hard" "Z3 Moderate" "Z2 Light" "Z1 Very Light""}},"ds_workout_zones":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_heartrate person_id="$person$"
| append [search `widx` tag=wearable_workout person_id="$person$" | `dedup_workouts` | eval _time=workout_start_epoch]
| append [search `widx` tag=wearable_daily wearable_dataset=person_info person_id="$person$" earliest=-2d latest=now | head 1 | eval vendor_age=age | fields vendor_age]
| append [| inputlookup wearable_person_profile where person_id="$person$" | eval birth_age=if(match(birth_ym,"^\d{4}-\d{2}$"),floor((now()-strptime(birth_ym."-15","%Y-%m-%d"))/31557600),null()) | fields birth_age]
| append [search `widx` tag=wearable_heartrate person_id="$person$" | where bpm<=200 | eval d=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d") | stats min(bpm) as dm by d | stats median(dm) as resting_hr | fields resting_hr]
| eventstats max(vendor_age) as vendor_age max(birth_age) as birth_age max(resting_hr) as resting_hr
| eval user_age=coalesce(birth_age, vendor_age)
| eval is_workout=if(isnotnull(workout_start_epoch),1,0)
| sort workout_start_epoch
| streamstats current=t last(eval(if(is_workout=1,workout_id,null()))) as active_id last(eval(if(is_workout=1,workout_end_epoch,null()))) as active_end last(eval(if(is_workout=1,workout_start_epoch,null()))) as active_start
| eval max_hr_cap=round(208-0.7*user_age,0)
| eval inw=if(isnotnull(bpm) AND isnotnull(active_end) AND _time>=active_start AND _time<=active_end,1,0)
| eval bpm=if(inw=1 AND isnotnull(max_hr_cap) AND bpm>max_hr_cap*1.2,null(),bpm)
| eventstats avg(eval(if(inw=1,bpm,null()))) as avg_hr max(eval(if(inw=1,bpm,null()))) as max_hr_reached count(eval(if(inw=1,1,null()))) as samples by active_id
| where is_workout=1
| eval hrr=max_hr_cap-resting_hr, pct=(avg_hr-resting_hr)/hrr
| eval Zone=case(isnull(avg_hr) OR isnull(resting_hr) OR isnull(hrr) OR hrr<=0,"—",pct<0.6,"Z1 Very Light",pct<0.7,"Z2 Light",pct<0.8,"Z3 Moderate",pct<0.9,"Z4 Hard",true(),"Z5 Max")
| eval Start=strftime(workout_start_epoch,"%b %d %H:%M"), Duration=round((workout_end_epoch-workout_start_epoch)/60,0)." min", "Avg HR"=if(isnull(avg_hr),"—",tostring(round(avg_hr,0))), Calories=if(isnull(workout_calories),"—",tostring(round(workout_calories,0))), Sources=mvjoin(session_vendors,", ")
| rename workout_activity_canon as Activity
| sort -workout_start_epoch
| head 15
| table Start, Activity, Duration, Calories, "Avg HR", Zone, Sources","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$global_time.earliest$","latest":"$global_time.latest$"}},"name":"Workout zones (Oura-detected)"},"ds_zone_inputs":{"type":"ds.chain","name":"Karvonen inputs (age/RHR/maxHR/HRR)","options":{"extend":"ds_karvonen_base","query":"| table age, resting_hr, max_hr, hrr"}},"ds_zone_boundaries":{"type":"ds.chain","name":"HR zone BPM boundaries","options":{"extend":"ds_karvonen_base","query":"| eval z1_b=round(resting_hr+0.5*hrr,0), z2_b=round(resting_hr+0.6*hrr,0), z3_b=round(resting_hr+0.7*hrr,0), z4_b=round(resting_hr+0.8*hrr,0), z5_b=round(resting_hr+0.9*hrr,0)
| eval row=" ", "Z5 Max"=max_hr-z5_b, "Z4 Hard"=z5_b-z4_b, "Z3 Moderate"=z4_b-z3_b, "Z2 Light"=z3_b-z2_b, "Z1 Very Light"=z2_b-z1_b, "Z0 Recovery"=z1_b
| table row "Z5 Max" "Z4 Hard" "Z3 Moderate" "Z2 Light" "Z1 Very Light" "Z0 Recovery""}},"ds_hr_zones_v2":{"type":"ds.chain","name":"HR zone timeline","options":{"extend":"ds_zone_base","query":"| eval zone_num=case(pct<0.5,1,pct<0.6,2,pct<0.7,3,pct<0.8,4,pct<0.9,5,true(),6)

| where stage!="Unknown"

| append [| inputlookup wearable_person_profile where person_id="$person$"
| eval birth_age=if(match(birth_ym,"^\d{4}-\d{2}$"),floor((now()-strptime(birth_ym."-15","%Y-%m-%d"))/31557600),null())
| fields birth_age]
| append [search `widx` tag=wearable_heartrate person_id="$person$"
| where bpm<=200
| eval d=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d")
| stats min(bpm) as dm by d
| stats median(dm) as resting_hr
| fields resting_hr]
| eventstats max(vendor_age) as vendor_age, max(birth_age) as birth_age, max(resting_hr) as resting_hr
| eval user_age=coalesce(birth_age, vendor_age)
| where isnotnull(bpm)
| dedup _time
| eval max_hr=round(208-0.7*user_age,0)
| where bpm<=max_hr*1.2
| eval hrr=max_hr-resting_hr, pct=(bpm-resting_hr)/hrr

| where bpm<=200

| append [| inputlookup wearable_person_profile where person_id="$person$"

| stats max(resting_hr) as resting_hr, max(vendor_age) as vendor_age, max(birth_age) as birth_age

| eval max_hr=round(208-0.7*age,0), hrr=max_hr-resting_hr"}},"ds_person_list":{"type":"ds.search","name":"People for the picker (registry)","options":{"query":"| tstats count where `widx` by person_id
